guidance: The guidance on cost -to-average below 2.5%, GNPA below 2.5%, NNPA below 1%, ROE greater than 13.5% have been met in Q4 and repeated in Q1.

risks: This quarter was replete with geopolitical uncertainties, rising inflation, and supply chain disruptions.
So there is some bit of pressure, but that's not really reflecting in the financial system.
